user.title: Cesta
user.description: Adds a visual shopping list with its own sidebar panel, a dashboard card and an Assist-compatible to-do list.

add_item.name: Add to basket
add_item.description: Adds a product to the list. Known products get their icon and department automatically.

stores.name: Stores
stores.description: Where to buy it. Unknown stores are created.

department.name: Department
department.description: Department name or id. Guessed if omitted.

complete_item.name: Mark as purchased
complete_item.description: Removes a product from the list and moves it to "Recently purchased".

get_items.name: Get list
get_items.description: Returns pending products sorted by department, plus a ready-to-send text.

store.name: Store
store.description: Only products for this store (and those with no store).
